<documents>
<document id="support-financial-abuse">
IfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoneyˆIfˆsomeoneˆisˆcontrollingˆyourˆmoney,ˆpressuringˆyouˆtoˆhandˆitˆover,ˆorˆusingˆyourˆaccountˆwithoutˆyourˆpermission,ˆyou'reˆnotˆalone,ˆandˆweˆcanˆhelp.ˆ##ˆTellˆusˆsafelyˆMessageˆsupportˆinˆtheˆappˆwhenˆit'sˆsafe.ˆYouˆcanˆuseˆaˆcodeˆphraseˆlikeˆ"Iˆneedˆtoˆtalkˆaboutˆmyˆaccountˆsecurity"ˆifˆsomeoneˆmightˆseeˆyourˆscreen.ˆSupportˆwillˆpassˆyourˆcaseˆtoˆourˆAccountˆServicesˆteam,ˆwhoˆareˆtrainedˆtoˆhelp.ˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆcanˆdoˆ-ˆChangeˆyourˆpasswordˆandˆsignˆoutˆotherˆdevicesˆ-ˆFreezeˆorˆreplaceˆyourˆcardˆ-ˆStopˆsendingˆpaperˆmailˆtoˆyourˆaddressˆ-ˆTalkˆaboutˆoptionsˆforˆmovingˆmoneyˆyouˆneedˆtoˆkeepˆsafeˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆwon'tˆdoˆWeˆwon'tˆtellˆanyoneˆelseˆyouˆcontactedˆus.ˆ##ˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆdangerˆIfˆyou'reˆinˆimmediateˆdanger,ˆcallˆemergencyˆservicesˆfirst.ˆAccountˆServicesˆrepliesˆwithinˆ2ˆbusinessˆdays,ˆandˆfasterˆwhenˆyouˆtellˆusˆit'sˆurgent.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="card-renewal">
CardˆexpiryˆandˆrenewalˆWeˆmailˆaˆnewˆcardˆautomaticallyˆaboutˆ30ˆdaysˆbeforeˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆexpires.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆaskˆforˆit.ˆ##ˆWhatˆchangesˆTheˆrenewedˆcardˆhasˆtheˆsameˆcardˆnumber,ˆaˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆaˆnewˆsecurityˆcode.ˆMostˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoreˆyourˆcardˆgetˆtheˆnewˆexpiryˆdateˆautomatically,ˆbutˆsomeˆdon't,ˆsoˆcheckˆyourˆsubscriptions.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆwhenˆitˆarrivesˆActivateˆtheˆnewˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYourˆoldˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆnewˆoneˆorˆuntilˆitˆexpires,ˆwhicheverˆcomesˆfirst.ˆ##ˆIfˆitˆdoesn'tˆarriveˆCheckˆthatˆyourˆaddressˆinˆtheˆappˆisˆcurrent.ˆIfˆyourˆoldˆcardˆexpiresˆandˆtheˆnewˆoneˆstillˆhasn'tˆarrived,ˆmessageˆsupportˆandˆwe'llˆsendˆanotherˆoneˆatˆnoˆcost.ˆ##ˆNoˆrenewal?ˆIfˆyourˆaccountˆisˆrestrictedˆorˆunderˆreview,ˆweˆcan'tˆsendˆaˆrenewalˆcardˆuntilˆthat'sˆresolved.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="security-never-ask">
Whatˆwe'llˆneverˆaskˆyouˆScammersˆoftenˆpretendˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbank.ˆHere'sˆwhatˆTallowbrookˆwillˆneverˆaskˆyouˆfor,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemail,ˆchatˆorˆsocialˆmedia.ˆ##ˆWeˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆ-ˆYourˆfullˆcardˆnumberˆorˆsecurityˆcodeˆ-ˆYourˆPINˆ-ˆYourˆpasswordˆorˆpasscodeˆ-ˆAˆone-timeˆcodeˆweˆsentˆyouˆ-ˆRemoteˆaccessˆtoˆyourˆphoneˆorˆcomputerˆ-ˆToˆmoveˆyourˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆ"safeˆaccount"ˆtoˆprotectˆitˆ-ˆToˆbuyˆgiftˆcardsˆorˆsendˆcryptocurrencyˆ##ˆWhatˆweˆmightˆaskˆInˆtheˆapp,ˆsupportˆmayˆaskˆyouˆtoˆconfirmˆrecentˆtransactionsˆorˆyourˆaddress.ˆThat'sˆinˆyourˆsigned-inˆsession,ˆwhereˆweˆalreadyˆknowˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆIfˆsomeoneˆasksˆStop,ˆhangˆupˆorˆcloseˆtheˆchat.ˆOpenˆtheˆTallowbrookˆappˆyourselfˆandˆmessageˆus.ˆDon'tˆcallˆaˆnumberˆorˆtapˆaˆlinkˆtheˆpersonˆgaveˆyou.ˆOurˆrealˆphoneˆnumberˆisˆinˆtheˆappˆunderˆHelp.ˆIfˆyouˆalreadyˆsharedˆaˆcodeˆorˆpassword,ˆchangeˆyourˆpasswordˆrightˆawayˆandˆmessageˆusˆsoˆweˆcanˆsecureˆyourˆaccount.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
